text:
katie lee: heads-up: updating hello-container quickstart to SDK v8 auth helpers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3522 — running locally I get 401 from example.

omar rivas: likely env var rename again? what env are you exporting?

katie lee: I had REDWOOD_TOKEN in the README and Dockerfile. new helper expects REDWOOD_API_KEY + createClientFromEnv().

kevin cho: yep. quickstarts should show a tiny bash export and the helper. keep examples <=6 lines.

katie lee: plan: replace var, add Node + Python snippets, restore Dockerfile ARG example, and add a secrets callout.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #3522: lint, linkcheck.

docs-bot: linkcheck: warning: docs/quickstart/hello-container.md line 27 -> https://old.example/auth (redirect).

omar rivas: update to /docs/auth and add a one-liner for KMS customers: "see /enterprise/kms".

katie lee: added snippets:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<YOUR_KEY>
```
```js
import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClientFromEnv();
const r = await client.generate({model:'redwood-v1', prompt:'hi'});
console.log(r.text);
```
kevin cho: nit: show REDWOOD_API_KEY without quotes in bash to avoid paste issues. also add a sentence: "do not bake keys into images" with link to /docs/security/secrets.

katie lee: fixed, pushed. Assigned reviewers @omar and @kevin. Added TODO to open CI smoke test to build quickstarts.

docs-bot: PR #3522 all checks passed. ready for review.

kevin cho: LGTM, merging now. Small win for onboarding.
